Definition: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
BiblicalUsage: 1) to come near, approach, enter into, draw near; 1a) (Qal) to approach, draw near; 1b) (Niphal) to be brought near; 1c) (Piel) to cause to approach, bring near, cause to draw near; 1d) (Hiphil) to bring near, bring, present
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
